caseNameFull: McCoy v. Crawford, Sheriff Hogge v. Cunningham, Penitentiary Superintendent Hayes v. California Burleson v. New Mexico and Ex parte Hill
attorneys: Petitioners pro se. C. Donald Robertson, Attorney General of West Virginia, and George H. Mitchell and Simon M. Bailey, Assistant Attorneys General, for respondent in No. 25, Mise.

opinions.text: Motions for leave to file petitions for writs of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
